letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai feels brighter, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. As we stroll between skyscrapers and spice markets, I’m reminded how lucky I am to share this wild, beautiful life with my favorite cutie. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my daily sunrise. No matter the time zone, my heart beats in sync with yours, counting the moments until we’re together again. I love you more than words can ever paint.
poem:
From desert dunes to monsoon rain,  
Your love’s the compass, soft and plain.  
In every city, near or far,  
You’re my forever, my brightest star.
